tagline: From zero to hero — hear it, know it, send it.

onboard.hearBody: Every letter is a rhythm of dots and dashes — we play it for you.
onboard.knowBody: Short lessons teach you to recognize each sound by ear, one letter at a time.
onboard.sendBody: Tap out the code yourself with the spacebar, mouse, or touch.

tour.title: Quick tour
tour.learnBody: A Koch-ordered lesson path — a few new letters at a time, with a quiz after each.
tour.practiceBody: Free drills outside the lesson path: random groups, words, callsigns, QSOs, and a warm-up that targets the letters you keep missing.
tour.sendBody: Key Morse yourself with the spacebar, mouse, or touch — your own timing gets decoded back to text.
tour.progressBody: Per-character accuracy and session history, so you can see exactly what needs more practice.
tour.referenceBody: The full alphabet at a glance, including a mnemonic table that draws each letter's dots and dashes right onto its shape.
tour.wikiBody: The history of Morse code, distress signals, prosigns, and Q-codes — tap any of them to hear it.
tour.settingsBody: Simple by default. Turn on Advanced settings for fine-grained speed and tone controls, switch language, or back up your progress.

installHint: Install Morse Trainer on your device for quick, offline access.
installIOSHint: Add Morse Trainer to your Home Screen: tap the Share icon, then "Add to Home Screen".
